entities.summary: Liberato Damião Ribeiro Pinto ComTE, ComC, ComA, ComSE, was a Portuguese Lieutenant Colonel of the Republican National Guard, politician and President of the Ministry of one of the governments of the Portuguese First Republic. He was the Portuguese head of government for a short time from 1920 to 1921 and the 44th Minister of Finance of Portugal from 22 February 1921 until 2 March 1921.
